summary: Part 6 covers s0067-s0076 after Huang’s 咸康三年 kingship. Ke’s sortie, Fancheng garrison and Miyun ambush (with Ma Qiu, Yang Yu and Xianyu Liang) correctly use a 337-338 window: Jinshu is undated locally and ZZTJ places them in Xiankang 4 (AD 338). The s0072 Jin titles are mis-anchored to sourceDate 咸康三年 and hint AD 337; ZZTJ gives Xiankang 4/4 = AD 338. All s0073-s0076 claims that borrow 又聞庾亮薨 / AD 340 are wrong: that clause starts at s0077, Yu Liang died in Xiankang 6/1 (AD 340), and ZZTJ dates Ping’s Liaoxi victory, Duan Liao’s death and Liu Xiang’s embassy to Xiankang 5 (AD 339). claim-437 misreads 雖稱燕王 as a 340 assumption. No birth or age appears in these units; deaths of Huyan Huang, Zhang Zhi and Duan Liao are present. Not a full-chapter approval.

references.reason: Undated Liaoxi victory and beheadings wrongly hung on 庾亮 in the claims.
Duan Liao’s execution; no year in-unit.

references.quote: 皝雖稱燕王，未有朝命，乃遣其長史劉祥獻捷京師
references.reason: Already-styled king without mandate plus Liu Xiang embassy; not a fresh 340 assumption.
First appearance of the Yu Liang death notice; must not be copied backward onto s0073-s0076.

references.title: 资治通鉴/卷096 咸康四年
references.quote: 皝遣其子恪帅二千骑追击之，赵兵大败，斩获三万馀级。
references.reason: Places Ke’s pursuit after Shi Hu’s withdrawal from Jicheng in Xiankang 4 (AD 338), matching s0067-s0069.

references.title: 资治通鉴/卷096 咸康四年十二月
references.quote: 十二月，段辽自密云山遣使求迎于赵；既而中悔，复遣使求迎于燕。
references.reason: Dates Duan Liao’s double dealing and the Miyun ambush sequence to Xiankang 4/12 (AD 338).

references.title: 资治通鉴/卷096 咸康四年四月
references.quote: 夏，四月，癸丑，以慕容皝为征北大将军、幽州牧，领平州刺史。
references.reason: Point date for the Jin title advancement corresponding to s0072: Xiankang 4/4 = AD 338.

references.title: 资治通鉴/卷096 咸康五年
references.quote: 燕前军师慕容评、广威将军慕容军、折冲将军慕舆根、荡寇将军慕舆泥袭赵辽西，俘获千馀家而去。赵镇远将军石成、积弩将军呼延晃、建威将军张支等追之，评等与战，斩晃、支首。
references.reason: Dates Murong Ping’s Liaoxi victory and the deaths of Huyan Huang and Zhang Zhi to Xiankang 5 (AD 339).

references.title: 资治通鉴/卷096 咸康五年
references.quote: 段辽谋反于燕，燕人杀辽及其党与数十人，送辽首于赵。
references.reason: Dates Duan Liao’s execution to Xiankang 5 (AD 339), against the claim’s AD 340.

references.title: 资治通鉴/卷096 咸康五年冬
references.quote: 燕王皝自以称王未受晋命，冬，遣长史刘翔、参军鞠运来献捷论功，且言权假之意，并请刻期大举，共平中原。
references.reason: Dates Liu Xiang’s embassy to winter of Xiankang 5 (AD 339).

references.title: 资治通鉴/卷096 咸康六年
references.quote: 春，正月，庚子朔，都亭文康侯庾亮薨。
references.reason: Yu Liang died Xiankang 6/1 (AD 340); that date belongs to s0077 又聞庾亮薨, not to s0073-s0076.
